summary.text: Jennifer Bradley has represented District 6 in the Florida Senate since being elected in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Bradley is an attorney and has been a member of The Florida Bar since 1995; Bradley holds a B.A. in criminology from the University of Florida (1991) and a J.D. from Florida State University (1995).
Bradley was born at Tachikawa U.S. Air Base in Tokyo, Japan, and moved to Florida in 1988; Bradley's spouse, Rob Bradley, served in the Florida Senate from 2012 to 2020.
